primary_professional_lens: Principal Industrial Design Sketching Instructor focusing on visual communication quality: spatial relationships, form clarity, line confidence, and ideation drawing conventions in conveying designer intent

visible_evidence_items.observed_feature: Continuous curved wooden frame with organic leg splay and integrated armrests shown in consistent orthographic and perspective views
visible_evidence_items.professional_interpretation: Strong form clarity and confident line weight communicate structural flow and ergonomic intent effectively across multiple angles

visible_evidence_items.observed_feature: Knotted tubular light-blue upholstery suspended on thin metal rods forming back and seat planes
visible_evidence_items.professional_interpretation: The repetitive knot pattern is rendered with sufficient resolution to suggest flexibility and texture, yet remains abstract enough for early ideation

visible_evidence_items.observed_feature: Four distinct viewpoints (front-three-quarter, rear-three-quarter, front, side) with consistent lighting and shadow
visible_evidence_items.professional_interpretation: Multi-view presentation enhances spatial legibility and allows evaluation of posture accommodation from multiple user perspectives

creativity.reasoning: The knotted tubular suspension system introduces an inventive, tactile approach to flexible support that responds to varied postures

originality.reasoning: Departs from conventional upholstered easy chairs through the visible knotted rope-like construction and exposed metal rod framework

usefulness_relevance.reasoning: The flexible knotted surface and wide seat appear suitable for 1-3h use and multiple postures, but armrest height and lumbar specificity remain visually ambiguous

clarity.reasoning: Multiple rendered views with consistent perspective and material indication provide excellent spatial and structural legibility

level_of_detail_elaboration.reasoning: Sufficient resolution for concept stage: wood grain, knot texture, and metal hardware are indicated without over-rendering

feasibility.reasoning: Wooden frame and rod suspension appear plausible, yet the complex knotting and long-term durability of the textile elements require further technical resolution

uncertainties: exact joinery method between wooden frame members and metal rods
material specification and long-term compression behavior of the knotted elements
recommendations: Add quick orthographic line sketches with dimension callouts to strengthen spatial communication
Include a simple posture diagram overlay showing user positions supported by the knotted surface
